description: This file implements tracing and profiling utilities for Chromium's build system, including classes and functions for logging, summarizing, and exporting trace events in JSON format.

classes.name: TraceLog
classes.description: Manages a thread-safe collection of trace events.

classes.name: TraceItem
classes.description: Represents a single trace event with timing and metadata.

classes.name: ScopedTrace
classes.description: Utility for automatically logging the duration of a scope.

classes.name: Coalesced
classes.description: Helper struct for aggregating trace durations by name.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a trace event to the log.

methods.name: events
methods.description: Returns a thread-safe copy of all trace events.

methods.name: TraceItem
methods.description: Constructor for creating a trace event.

methods.name: ScopedTrace
methods.description: Constructor and destructor for scope-based tracing.

methods.name: SetToolchain
methods.description: Associates a toolchain label with a trace event.

methods.name: SetCommandLine
methods.description: Associates command line arguments with a trace event.

methods.name: Done
methods.description: Marks the end of a trace event.

methods.name: AddTrace
methods.description: Adds a trace event to the global log.

methods.name: SummarizeTraces
methods.description: Generates a summary report of collected trace events.

methods.name: SaveTraces
methods.description: Exports trace events to a JSON file for visualization.
